title: Knowledge Structure
definition: The method of organizing and connecting knowledge, enabling both structured navigation and emergent relationship discovery.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Imagine organizing a library with both clear book categories and hidden connections between books. That's how knowledge structure works.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: A dual-mode knowledge structure combines hierarchical categorization with organic, non-linear connections. It allows for structured navigation and the discovery of unexpected relationships.
difficulty_levels.expert: Knowledge structure is a hybrid representation combining directed acyclic hierarchies with small-world network properties. This results in a resilient system that balances efficiency and flexibility, while enabling the exploration of both known and unknown relationships.

extra_fields.insight: The combination of hierarchical categorization with organic, non-linear connections enables both structured navigation and emergent relationship discovery in knowledge organization.
